introHtml: Yellow office supplies bring energy and visibility to any workspace. From branded yellow sticky notes and highlighters to custom yellow pens and folders, this color helps important messages stand out. Safety managers often choose yellow for compliance materials, while marketing directors use it to reinforce brand recognition. Decorate with screen printing or engraving for a polished look that lasts through daily use.
